# Morshed Alam — Creative Multimedia Designer

> Motion Graphics Designer and Video Editor based in Dubai, UAE. Working at ENTERTAINER FZ LLC, specializing in campaign films, launch films, and seasonal narratives using After Effects, Cinema 4D, VEO3, and Runway.
